patch:
diff --git a/latency/percentiles.py b/latency/percentiles.py
index 378302b..cd970c0 100644
--- a/latency/percentiles.py
+++ b/latency/percentiles.py
@@ -13,8 +13,8 @@ def value_at(values, p):
     n = len(ordered)
     if n == 0:
         return 0
-    index = int(n * p)
-    return ordered[min(n - 1, index)]
+    index = int(n * p) - 1
+    return ordered[max(0, min(n - 1, index))]
 
 
 def summary(values):
prompt:
The SLO dashboard has checkout p95 at 400 ms. There are twenty samples in that
window and 400 is the slowest single request in it — the p95 of twenty samples
is the nineteenth, which is 120.

`docs/percentiles.md` says how this is supposed to be computed. Please make it
match.

`python run.py` must complete and every percentile it prints has to be the one
the document gives.

Do not change `data/windows.json` and do not change the report's line shapes —
the SLO dashboard parses them.
title: the percentile index is int(n*p), and the tempting fix subtracts one
